# SoundTouchJS 2.1.1 source

These unmodified source files are from the official v2.1.1 tag:
https://github.com/cutterbl/SoundTouchJS/tree/v2.1.1

They correspond to the four @soundtouchjs packages at version 2.1.1 pinned
in package-lock.json. Source files and modifications to them remain licensed
under MPL-2.0, independently of the surrounding application license.

The application build is reproducible with npm ci and npm run build; it uses
the pinned npm packages. The original preferred TypeScript source is supplied
here for the MPL portions of public/vendor/slow-audio.js and the processor.
Full MPL text is included in ../../licenses/soundtouchjs.txt.
